pages.title: Snow
pages.text: Snow falls from the sky and settles into a thin layer. Through the lens, I can see aether taking shape with each flake; dissolving that layer returns part of it.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: After a long interval, the device collects snow in $(l)its own chunk$(), from one block below to two above. More accumulated snow means more aether. A newly placed device waits a full cycle too.$(br2)A golem confined to one corner supplies very little each cycle. Give it a longer route, or let a broad field catch the snowfall.
